newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Rayon, Siam Cement group to tie up.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Rayon, Siam Cement group to tie up.

text.p: Mitsubishi Rayon Co Ltd said on Thursday that it would set up a joint venture with Thailand's Siam Cement group to begin production of methyl methacrylate in Thailand in early 1999.
The total investment would be about 12 billion yen, a Mitsubishi Rayon spokeswoman said.

Methyl methacrylate is a material used in various plastic parts for cars, electrical appliances and houses, she said. The venture, to be headquartered in Bangkok, will build a plant at Rayong, southeast of Bangkok. It will initially be capable of producing 55,000 tonnes of methyl methacrylate a year.
